id.description: The ID of the Pay Request generated by Tyro.

mid.description: The merchant ID of the terminal as specified by the Tyro Account.

tid.description: The terminal ID of the Tyro Terminal.

origin.description: Contains information from the partner that created the Pay Request.

orderId.description: An identifier that has been generated by the origin. This can be used for reconciliation of orders in the app partner’s system.

transactionId.description: A UUIDv4 provided by the partner to be used for preventing duplicate transactions, for us in reinitialisation of the terminal on an already attempted pending transaction.

name.description: Name or reference for this transaction used by the partner that created the Pay Request.

status.description: The current status of this Pay Request managed by Tyro.

transactionProgress.description: Additional information about the status of the transaction.

id.description: The id of the transaction progress message. This can be used to determine further detail of what occurred during processing such as "COMPLETE", "PENDING", "REJECTED", "DEAD"

description.description: The free text description of the transaction progress message.

allOf.description: The total amount (in smallest currency unit)

pendingDecision.description: The pending decision to be displayed on the POS. Values for this may be related to printing a receipt, or asking for a signature.

decisionId.description: The ID of the pending decision.

question.description: The question to be displayed on the POS.

items.description: The options to be displayed on the POS.

terminalProgress.description: The progress message displayed on the terminal.

id.description: The id of the terminal progress message. You can use this to filter what messages you would wish to display on the POS, or to customize messages.

description.description: The free text description of the terminal progress message.

transactionOutcome.description: The outcome of the transaction after it has been processed by the terminal.

transactionResult.description: The outcome of the transaction after it has been processed by the terminal. "Approved", "Declined", "Terminated", "Cancelled"

approvalCode.description: The response code from the terminal. This is a numeric string that represents the outcome of the transaction.

transactionReference.description: The transaction reference number from the terminal. This is a unique identifier for the transaction.

authorisationNumber.description: The authorisation number from the acquirer. This is a unique identifier for the transaction.

cardType.description: The card type used in the transaction.

elidedPan.description: The PAN with all but the last 4 digits replaced with 'X'.

retrievalReferenceNumber.description: The retrieval reference number. This is a unique identifier for the transaction.

surchargeAmount.description: The surcharge amount in the smallest currency unit.

tipAmount.description: The tip amount in the smallest currency unit.

totalAmount.description: The total amount including any surcharge or tip in the smallest currency unit.

receipts.description: This object contains printable receipts for the customer and merchant.

customer.description: This will be a printable receipt for the customer

merchant.description: This will be a printable receipt for the merchant

signature.description: This will be a printable receipt for the merchant if signature is required

goodsAndServicesAmount.description: This is the goods and services amount in smallest currency unit. e.g 12520 (in cents) is $125.20. It can be used in combination with cashoutAmount. It cannot be used in combination with refundAmount.

cashoutAmount.description: This is the requested cashout amount in smallest currency unit. e.g 5000 (in cents) is $50.00. It can be used in combination with goodsAndServicesAmount. It cannot be used in combination with refundAmount.

refundAmount.description: This is the refund amount in smallest currency unit. e.g 12520 (in cents) is $125.20. It cannot be used in combination with goodsAndServicesAmount or cashoutAmount.
